title: Didn't work for me...
text: Didn't work for me.... This did not work for me. I followed the directions and even watched a video to see exactly how to do it. My bags busted because of the force I had to use to squeeze my icing out. I used a homemade buttercream frosting, maybe it was too thick but I really feel like it should have worked. I use regular piping bags with no trouble at all. Not sure what went wrong. Probably won't use it again.

product_metadata.title: Wilton Color Swirl, 3-Color Piping Bag Coupler, 9-Piece Cake Decorating Kit
features: Make tri-color swirls of icing on your cupcakes with this three-color coupler set
Includes coupler, decorating tips 1M, 1A and 6—16-inch disposable decorating bags
Color: Purple and white coupler; silver decorating tips
Before first and after each use, wash coupler and tips in warm, soapy water
description: Brighten up your cupcakes with rainbow icing swirls using the Wilton Color Swirl. This three-color coupler lets you pipe three different shades of icing at once. Includes the tri-color icing coupler, 1M and 1A icing tips and disposable piping bags.
